description: This is a PHP unit test class for the DetailedLeaveRequest data transfer object (DTO) within the OrangeHRM Leave module. It contains setup methods, test cases for single-day and multi-day leave requests, and tests involving leave periods and allowed actions. The class interacts with various service classes, mock objects, and entity references to validate the behavior of DetailedLeaveRequest.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Tests\Leave\Dto\LeaveRequest\DetailedLeaveRequestTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for the DetailedLeaveRequest DTO, testing leave request behaviors, including setup, leave details, allowed actions, and leave periods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data from a fixture YAML file before each test.

methods.name: testEmptyLeaveRequest
methods.description: Tests behavior when an empty LeaveRequest is wrapped by DetailedLeaveRequest, checking exception handling.

methods.name: testSingleDayLeaveRequest
methods.description: Verifies details for a single-day leave request, including date and duration properties.

methods.name: testMultiDayLeaveRequestFirstDayHoliday
methods.description: Checks allowed actions when the first day of a multi-day leave request falls on a holiday.

methods.name: testMultiStatusLeaveRequest
methods.description: Validates behavior when a leave request has multiple statuses and restricted actions.

methods.name: setServices
methods.description: Configures mock services and dependencies needed for tests, including user and leave services.

methods.name: testGetLeavePeriodsWithAssignedLeaveForPastLeavePeriod
methods.description: Tests retrieval of leave periods, particularly for past periods with assigned leave, based on current date.
